book.name: Aj Filipos
book.title: Tuꞌj Pabl kye Nimil aj Filipos

content: Qo ok tzeꞌnku te Jesucrist

Atzin jaꞌlin, qatzin qa twutzxix qa a Crist nqꞌonte ambꞌil kyeꞌy, tuꞌn tjaw kyin kyibꞌa; ex qa at-xix qꞌuqbꞌil kꞌuꞌjbꞌaj kyukꞌiy; ex qa at Xewbꞌaj Xjan kyxola; ex qa kyojtzqiꞌnxixa tsoꞌjbꞌajil Jesús, ex qa at tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil tkꞌuꞌj kyukꞌiy; qa twutzxix kykyaqiljo luꞌn,
kyqꞌonktzintza jun kytzaljbꞌila weꞌy, tuꞌn kyyekꞌin kyibꞌa, tuꞌntla junx tuꞌn tbꞌete kynabꞌla, ex junx tqꞌaqꞌbꞌil kykꞌuꞌja, ex tukꞌa junxchꞌin kyumila ex junxchꞌin kyajbꞌila.

Mit kubꞌ kybꞌinchiꞌn jun tiꞌ noq tuꞌnjo at tajbꞌin kyeꞌy, ex nya tukꞌa kynimsbꞌil kyibꞌa, qalaꞌ tukꞌa kymutxbꞌil kyibꞌa teyile junjun, ex tuꞌn kyximiꞌn kyiꞌjjo txqantl, qa nimxixtl kyoklin toj taqꞌin qMan Dios.
Mix aꞌl jun kyeꞌ, tuꞌn tkubꞌ tbꞌinchin jun tiꞌ, noq tuꞌn tknetjo a te teku, qalaꞌ noq tuꞌn tel wenku te tkyaqilx.
Junxit tel kyximbꞌitza kykyaqila, ikyxjo tzeꞌnku te Crist, a Jesús;
quꞌn ikyx t-xilin luꞌn:

content.text: me mix jaw tiꞌne tibꞌ, tuꞌn tok toklin tzeꞌn te Dios,
qalatziꞌn, bꞌeꞌx xkyij ttzaqpiꞌn toklin toj kyaꞌj,
exsin s-ok tqꞌoꞌn tibꞌtz tzeꞌnkuj jun kyaqꞌnilxjal.
ex xi tqꞌoꞌn tibꞌ tuꞌn tkyim twutzjo cruz;
ikytzin s-ele kyiꞌn xjaljo ttxꞌixew, nyakuj tzeꞌn jun aj il.
Tuꞌn xkubꞌ tnimintz ikyjo, ma tzaj tqꞌoꞌn Dios nimxix toklin,
ex ma tzꞌok qꞌoꞌn te tAjaw Tkyaqil,
Tunpetziꞌn, bꞌin quꞌn, qa nimxix toklin tbꞌi Jesús.
Ex tuꞌn ikyjo, noq twutz, kchi kꞌwele mejeye kꞌulil, a iteꞌ toj kyaꞌj, ikyqexjo a iteꞌ twutz txꞌotxꞌ, ex ikyqexjo tkyaqil kyimnin.
Tuꞌnpetziꞌn, tkyaqilx tuꞌn tkubꞌ nabꞌlinte, ex tuꞌn tkubꞌ qꞌmante,
qa oꞌkx Jesucrist, a tAjaw Tkyaqil, ok te nimsbꞌilte tbꞌi qMan Dios.

content: Awotzinqe a nimilqo, tuꞌn qok te jun yekꞌbꞌil kywutz nya nimil

Atzin jaꞌlin, werman, ex nimx nqꞌaqꞌin nkꞌuꞌja kyiꞌja; ikytziꞌn tzeꞌnkuj in kubꞌ kynimiꞌn, tej nteꞌn kyukꞌiy, exsintla nimxixtl tuꞌn nkubꞌ kynimiꞌn jaꞌlin, a najchaq intiniꞌy kykꞌatza. Quꞌn tuꞌnjo ma chi kleta, kyqꞌonktzin tilil, tuꞌn tkubꞌ kyniminjiꞌy kolbꞌil kyeꞌy, me tukꞌa kymutxbꞌil kyibꞌa, ex tuꞌn tten tchewil qMan Dios kyiꞌja.
Ikytziꞌn, ate Dios ktzajil qꞌonte tumil tiꞌjjo wen, a kyaja, ex ktzajil qꞌonte mojbꞌil kyeꞌy, tuꞌn tjapin bꞌajjo lo kyuꞌn, tzeꞌnku taj qMan Dios.
Kybꞌinchinkutziꞌn tkyaqilx tukꞌa tkyaqil kykꞌuꞌja, ex nya tuꞌn kyjaw chꞌotje, ex nya tuꞌn kyjaw yolbꞌiꞌn,

tuꞌntzin ntiꞌ kyila kywutzxjal, a nya nimilqe ex bꞌinchil ilqe. Qalaꞌ chi okxita tkꞌwal qMan Dios, ex ntiꞌtla kytzꞌilila toj kychwinqila. Qalaꞌ chi okxa tzꞌaqle wen, tzeꞌnqe cheꞌw nchi qoptzꞌaje toj qnikyꞌin; ex ikyxqetzintla kyejiꞌy tukꞌaꞌ kybꞌinchbꞌin toj kynimbꞌila kyxoljo nya nimil, a toj qxopin iteꞌye,

tuꞌntzin tjaw kynimsiꞌn toklin Tbꞌanil Tqanil tiꞌjjo saq chwinqil. Ikytziꞌn, aj tul Crist, ok knaꞌbꞌilx wejiꞌy tzaljbꞌil wen kyiꞌja, aj tok nkaꞌyiꞌn qa nya noqx kukxjo in aqꞌniꞌn kyxola, ex nya noqx kukxjo ma tzikyꞌx wuꞌn tuꞌn tpajjo in yoliꞌn tqanil kolbꞌil kyeꞌy.

Exla qa ma chin kyima tzaluꞌn toj tze noq tuꞌn kypaja, a noq tuꞌn tjapin bꞌajjo kynimbꞌila, a jun oyaj xi kyqꞌoꞌn twutz qMan Dios; ex ok kchin tzalajila ikyjo, tuꞌntzintla qtzalaj junx kyukꞌiy toj qnimbꞌil.
Nya tuꞌn ikyjo, qa ma chin kyima, chi kꞌwela numjiꞌy, qalaꞌ chi tzeꞌjexixa tzeꞌnku weꞌ.
Kabꞌe tbꞌanil nimil: Timotey ex Epafrodito
Atzin jaꞌlin, qa iky tajbꞌil qAjaw Jesús, nchin ximin tuꞌn t-xi smet Timotey liweyku te lol kyeꞌy. Ex qa bꞌaꞌn iteꞌyiꞌy, ikytzin k-ajbꞌile kyqaniljiꞌy te jun tzaljbꞌil te weꞌy.
Ikytzin mix aꞌl juntl nximin kyiꞌja tzeꞌn te Timotey. Ikyx t-ximjo kyiꞌja tzeꞌnku weꞌ nxim, quꞌn tok tilil tuꞌn, tuꞌn tonin kyukꞌiy.
Qalatzin kyeꞌ txqantl, noq te kyex kyeꞌ nchi ximin, ex nchi aqꞌnin; me atzin tiꞌjjo te Crist, a Jesús, mina nkubꞌ kyximin taqꞌin.
Me ikytzin bꞌin kyeꞌ kyuꞌn, ex ojtzqiꞌn kyeꞌ kyuꞌn, qa tzun n-aqꞌnin Timotey; ex tukꞌa tkyaqil tajbꞌil n-aqꞌnin wukꞌiy, tuꞌn tqꞌmet Tbꞌanil Tqanil kolbꞌil, iky tzeꞌnku jun kꞌwal n-ajbꞌin te ttata.
Tunpetziꞌn, ax kxel nchqꞌoꞌn te lol kyeꞌy, ex k-okil kybꞌiꞌn te, tzeꞌn intiniꞌy toj nchwinqila ex toj taqꞌin qAjaw Jesús.
Me qꞌuqle weꞌ nkꞌuꞌj tiꞌj qAjaw, tuꞌn njatza tzaluꞌn toj tze, ex loqinl weꞌ, liweyku chin poꞌn lol kyeꞌy.

Ex il tiꞌj tuꞌn taj nchqꞌoꞌn a erman Epafrodito, axj ten te mojil wukꞌiy toj aqꞌuntl, ex n-ikyꞌx yajbꞌil tuꞌn junx wukꞌiy, tuꞌn tqꞌmetjo Tyol Dios. Ex axjo erman, tzaj kychqꞌoꞌn te lolte weꞌy, tuꞌn tok bꞌinchit jun tiꞌ weꞌy.
Nkubꞌ t-ximin tuꞌn t-xiꞌ lol kyeꞌy kykyaqila, ex tuꞌn tpon tqanil kyeꞌy, tuꞌnjo chꞌime xkyime, teꞌ xyabꞌte, quꞌn ma kybꞌiꞌy qa ma yabꞌte.

Twutzx teꞌ, ma kubꞌ yabꞌte tetz, ex chꞌintlx mi xkyime. Bꞌaꞌnpetzin ma qꞌaqꞌin tkꞌuꞌj qMan Dios tiꞌj, ex nya noq oꞌkx tiꞌjkuꞌ erman, ex ikyxjo weꞌ, tuꞌn mi tzaje juntl bꞌis wiꞌja tibꞌajxiljo bꞌis tok wiꞌja tzaluꞌn toj tze.
Tuꞌntzintzjo, il tiꞌj tuꞌn t-xi nchqꞌoꞌn kykꞌatza tuꞌntzin tok kykaꞌyin twutz, ex tuꞌn kyjaw tzalaja, aj kylontiꞌy. Ex ikyx wejiꞌy, tuꞌn mi chin bꞌisintla tiꞌj kyqanila.
Kykꞌmonxa tukꞌa tkyaqil kytzaljbꞌila, tzeꞌnkux jun erman, a wenxix tiꞌj qAjaw Jesús, ex kynimsinqeksjiꞌy kykyaqil nimil, a ikyx tumiljo kyuꞌn tzeꞌnku erman lo.
Quꞌn, chjonte Dios, mi xkyim te erman tzaluꞌn, teꞌ attaq nkꞌatza, noq tuꞌn tpajjo n-ajbꞌin te Crist. Chꞌime xkyije tchwinqil noq tuꞌn tpajjo n-ajbꞌin weꞌy te kyxeljo, tuꞌntaq kymojin wukꞌiy.
